structure: Part 7 mined all 8 trace zips its read names, from two spec files in the tests repo's animals project, and read both specs. pages/contact-address.spec.ts (7): renders the page controls [5b1a7]; leaves the contact address unchecked on load [943a0]; accepts a valid contact address [60f4b]; a chosen contact address is shown as the current contact on return, still chosen, and saving again keeps it [2fe1e]; saving with no contact address selected is allowed and exits to the hub [2cb78]; offers no way to add an address in stub mode [676b1, skipped: its test.trace carries the skip annotation and ends after the beforeEach walk, so it shows the page as rendered outside stub mode]; links to INS to add an address when the full stack is running [b077b]. features/all-operators.spec.ts (1): check your answers lists all six operators with the picked name and country [5c7f8]. The bundled trace viewer refuses these zips (TraceVersionError: recorded by a newer Playwright), so each zip, already unzipped into this part's work folder, was read with jq: 1-trace.trace (before events for the action list, frame snapshots rendered back to HTML), 1-trace.network (resource snapshots with post params) and test.trace (steps and annotations). Refs name the trace by its folder hash fragment, then the call id. Pages in this slice, in the order a user meets them: (1) the Overview at /live-animals/notifications/{ref}, mined only for the '6. Contact address' task row and its status, the '5. Consignment parties' row hint and the Review and submit control; (2) the contact address page at /consignment/contact/select (h1 'Contact address for consignment'), always reachable from the Overview, whose variants are first visit (nothing checked, no current-contact card) and return after a save (saved radio checked plus a 'Current contact address' summary card), and whose 'Add a new address' link renders only outside stub mode; (3) Review your notification at /notification-view, reached only by 5c7f8 after a full journey walk, mined for '5. Consignment parties' (the Roles and addresses card, six rows) and '6. Contact address', plus the transporter card the test does not check. Every contact-address test reaches the page by the same beforeEach walk (new notification, origin, commodity). The all-operators walk passes through the addresses hub, the five role pickers, CPH, arrival, transit, transporter and contact pages; those pages belong to other parts and are recorded here only as the route. Network logs hold only browser-to-frontend traffic: the address-book read behind the radio list is server-side and never seen. No trace recorded a browser error. What is conditional: the current-contact card (only once a contact is saved), the checked radio (only once saved), the Add a new address link (only outside stub mode), and the Overview task status (To do until a contact is saved, then Complete). This run re-mined the slice and re-checked the earlier extract's claims for it against the traces, keeping their ids where they still hold.
